text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The "Arima Kinen." A special race where
the competing umamusume are chosen by fan votes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond was voted 2nd in the fan poll.
Taking 1st place was Kitasan Black.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Today's gotta go to Kitasan Black!
That tenacity down the stretch is just built different!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"She held her ground and found another gear!
No ordinary late charge is gonna catch her!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan is our shining star of hope!
We're rooting for her all the way!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Everyone was talking about Kita-chan,
weren't they?
choice_data_list: Diamond also finished a close second!
Diamond still got second by a hair, you know!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer...
You're being far too biased.
I really don't think 20,000 votes counts as a narrow margin.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
However, so many people voted for me.
I feel truly happy and honored by that♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: "...I was merely reflecting on how passionate Kita-chan's fans are with their support."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
In Kita-chan's case, it is not just "Do your best,"
but "I want to see you do your best."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Nnngh... I'd be lying if I said
I wasn't jealous, but...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: The grass is always greener on the other side, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Besides, when I think about disappointing
all of Kita-chan's fans,
my conscience does prick me a little.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Saying that, Satono Diamond flashed a mischievous smile. It was practically a declaration of victory.
She really is quite dependable.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
It's about time.
Well then, I'm off!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Making her dazzling entrance, the young lady bearing the name of a national treasure!
Fan Vote #2, Satono Diamond!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And finally, making her highly anticipated entrance!
The fan vote #1, Kitasan Black!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...Kita-chan, sorry to keep you waiting!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I was waiting for you, Dia-chan!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for waiting for me.
In today's race, I'm going to prove
that I've finally caught up to Kita-chan!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: No, I'm gonna pass Kita-chan in one go!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I won't give up the lead!!
Let's see who wins, Dia-chan!
